reuse.why: Extends the existing isNonWorkingDay predicate that all holiday checks in the tree go through.

duplication.why: The yearly match is added once, inside the single shared predicate.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts, and the format is also documented on RecurConfig.holidays.

scope.why: One predicate, a type comment, a focused test and a release note.

maintainability.why: A small, documented change at the one definition every caller shares.
